title: Internal Hom out of a lisse Weil sheaf is tensor with its dual
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$, an algebraic closure $k$ of $k_0$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k_0)$, and $\Qlb=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Let $X$ be a $k_0$-scheme locally of finite type, put $\bar X=X\times_{k_0}k$, and let $\Phi=1_X\times\operatorname{Spec}(\gamma)$ for inverse $q$-power Frobenius $\gamma$ of $k$, where $q=\#k_0$. On a small representative of $\bar X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention], let $R$ be the ring sheaf whose sections on $U$ are continuous functions $|U|\to\Qlb$ whose values locally span a finite-dimensional $\mathbf Q_\ell$-subspace. Write $\mathcal A$ for the category of $R$-module sheaves $F$ with an isomorphism $\theta_F:\Phi^*F\xrightarrow{\sim}F$, and maps commuting with $\theta_F$ (fixed pairs [def-weil-endofunctor-fixed-pair-category] in the sheaf category). Use the native derived category $D(\mathcal A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], formed by inverting equivariant quasi-isomorphisms. Write $H(A,B)=\mathcal Hom_R(A,B)$ with structure $h\mapsto\theta_B\Phi^*(h)\theta_A^{-1}$, and $H_A=H(A,-)$. For an additive functor $H_A$, its total right derived functor $RH_A$ is computed by applying $H_A$ termwise to a K-injective representative. Here a complex $I$ is K-injective if every map from an acyclic complex to $I$ is null-homotopic. The native bifunctor $\operatorname{RHom}_{\mathrm W}(K,N)$ is the image of $H^\bullet(J,I)$ for the chosen K-injective representatives $J,I$ of $K,N$, with $H^\bullet(J,I)^n=\prod_p H(J^p,I^{p+n})$ and differential $d(f)=d_I f-(-1)^n f d_J$. A native Weil complex is an object of $D(\mathcal A)$ with bounded constructible cohomology: locally on $\bar X$, each cohomology sheaf has a finite locally closed stratification on each stratum of which it is pro-etale locally finite free over $R$. Let $P$ be a Weil sheaf whose underlying $R$-module is pro-etale locally finite free of finite rank (lisse), and let $P^\vee=H(P,R)$, with the displayed contragredient structure, again lisse. Let $N$ be a native Weil complex. For lisse $G$ use precisely the upstream functor $T_G=RH_{G^\vee}$ restricted to native Weil complexes (Lean `WeilComplex.tensorLisse G`), and regard its value in $D(\mathcal A)$. Then there exists an isomorphism
$$T_{P^\vee}(N)\cong\operatorname{RHom}_{\mathrm W}(P[0],N)$$
in $D(\mathcal A)$. This is the tensor-with-the-dual / internal-Hom identity as typed by `AlgebraicGeometry.WeilComplex.nonempty_tensorLisse_dual_iso_derivedHom`; $P$ is in degree zero.

lean.statement:
theorem nonempty_tensorLisse_dual_iso_derivedHom (P : WeilSheaf k₀ l X) (hP : P.IsLisse)
    (N : WeilComplex k₀ l X) :
    Nonempty (((tensorLisse (P.dual hP) hP.dual).obj N).obj ≅
      (ProEtaleWeilSheaf.derivedHom k₀ l X N.obj).obj (op (WeilSheaf.toComplex.obj P).obj)) :=
  sorry
